findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: za_official_domain_check · Private data: za_tender_search, za_normalize_phone, domain_intel · Public sink: za_normalize_phone, za_email_security, domain_intel · Destructive: za_validate_tax_number, za_validate_company_number, za_normalize_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: za_official_domain_check · Private data: za_tender_search, za_normalize_phone, domain_intel · Public sink: za_normalize_phone, za_email_security, domain_intel · Destructive: za_validate_tax_number, za_validate_company_number, za_normalize_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
